info.title: API.SH: Mercado Libre
info.description: The Mercado Libre API from API.SH: public Mercado Libre data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Products for sale on any Mercado Libre / Mercado Livre country site, by keywords, category or seller, with sort, price range, condition and every filter the results page offers (pass a filter value's `url` back as `url`). Each result has its item and catalog product ids, title, link, price, previous price, discount, installments, condition, rating, seller and official-store flag, shipping labels and free shipping, highlight, variations, pictures, category and the original card in `raw`; the response adds the available and applied filters with their counts and links, and related searches. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page (the site shows up to 42 pages).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 2 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mercadolibre-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words.

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: Country site: ar (Argentina, default), br (Brazil, Mercado Livre), mx, cl, co, pe, uy, ve, ec, bo, py, do, pa, cr, gt, hn, ni, sv; the site ids MLA, MLB, MLM... also work. A link's own country wins.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id (from /mercadolibre/v1/categories), e.g. `MLA1055`; with or without `q`.

parameters.name: seller_id
parameters.description: Only this seller's listings (`seller.id` from /mercadolibre/v1/product).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Instead of the parameters above: a results link from the site or from a filter value's `url` in a previous response.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `relevance` (default), `price_low`, `price_high`.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum price in the site's currency.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum price in the site's currency.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: `new`, `used` or `refurbished`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1-42 (48 results a page).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
